session_summary: Phase 7: Mobile Experience & Polish complete. Implemented MobileDrawer bottom-sheet with FAB toggle, fixed ECCC weather condition codes 100-399, enhanced VesselCard with SOG/COG/heading/last-seen, and completed a full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility pass (5 issues fixed). PR #3 opened clean against master.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Extended weather condition codes and VesselCard in a single focused invocation — no wasted turns. Also correctly updated AIS types file.
Delivered MobileDrawer with correct dark maritime theme, safe-area-inset for notched phones, prefers-reduced-motion, and proper ARIA roles on the first attempt.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Focus management and focus trap were missing — caught by qa-tester in the next pass.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Add to ui-designer template: 'For any new interactive overlay (modal, drawer, sheet), implement focus trap and Escape key dismissal. These are WCAG 2.1 AA requirements, not polish.'

agent_feedback.worked_well: Caught 5 real a11y issues, fixed them inline, and opened the PR — all in one pass at 40 turns.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: None — 40 turn limit was the right call for this scope.

overall_notes: Pattern observed: ui-designer produces good visual output but misses ARIA/focus management. Recommend adding a mandatory a11y checklist to ui-designer template for interactive components. Sequential agent execution (not parallel) was necessary because agents share the workspace directory — concurrent git commits would conflict. This is a Voltron architecture note worth capturing.
